title: 第2章 成为了“高贵的管理员”
slug: 次元论坛全本免费-次元论坛最新章节列表
content_zh:
有人会回答“穿越到了危险的世界”、还有人会回答“穿越后没有金手指”、也有人会回答“穿越后就被人按在地上biu”……
好吧，关立远表示，这些三种情况自己都遇上了！
于是关立远决定，以此为题去“大宇宙论坛”里发个帖子发泄一下……
不过就在他用精神，在其他人看不到的论坛页面上，输入了帖子的标题之后，一只肥大的企鹅跳了出来，但是周围的人依旧对此视而不见，很显然这企鹅与论坛界面一样，也是其他人看不到的。
“喂喂，什么叫没有‘金手指’？我不就是你的‘金手指’吗？”
企鹅不满的摆弄了一下自己的红围脖……别问为什么明明是企鹅，还要带围脖！
“哎，主要是我觉得说自己‘没有金手指’，还可以欺骗自己是‘金手指没有觉醒’，要是承认了自己的‘金手指’只是个论坛，那就彻底没希望了啊！”关立远用一种不发出声音的形式，与企鹅交流着。
这是一个月以来，关立远最大的进步……终于能够控制自己与企鹅不出声的交流，而且只让他听见自己想“说出来”的！
“什么叫‘只’是个论坛？你有没有认识到‘大宇宙论坛’在论坛界的地位？这可是在每个宇宙，只能有一名注册会员、而且完全实行邀请制的高端论坛！你知道这意味着什么吗？”
“知道，通常做这种宣传的人都是骗子。”关立远更加不屑起来。
“你、你这是全宇宙……不，是所有宇宙加在一起，最恶毒的污蔑！要知道我的宗旨是：用心创造快乐！”
“……”
企鹅看到关立远不说话了，顿时觉得自己终于说服了这个不识好歹的家伙，虽然这家伙的眼神还是有点怪怪的。
似乎是觉得关立远的沉默，是在反思自己的错误，企鹅的语气也缓和了一些：“不要身在福中不知福了，如果不是系统检测到，你与本服务器的创造者们的灵魂波动体系高度一致，凭你被这个宇宙意志的‘青睐’的程度，成为论坛会员的概率都低到忽略不计，更别说是像现在这样，直接成为一名高贵的管理员了！”
被洗脑，对于智慧生物来说，是一件很恐怖的事情。
但是关立远表示，被一只带着红围脖的肥企鹅反复洗脑，让他接受“论坛管理员是一种光荣如共产主义事业接班人一样伟大的使命与职责”……这种洗脑简直毫无杀伤力啊！
“好吧，那么再向你确认一次，确定现在全版面中‘高贵的管理员’只有我一位是吗？”关立远问道。
“没错，本论坛在上线后，就与创造者世界‘失联’了……不过好消息是，除此之外、一切顺利，虽然运行了万年之久后，出现了无数的BUG，但是却又被我发现了你！所有能够联通的宇宙中，唯一拥有管理员资格的灵魂，现在那些BUG已经不成问题了！”企鹅说到这儿也松了口气。
“事先说明，权限狗……额，我是说管理员我还能胜任，不过程序员我就一窍不通了……”
“当然，我不是早就解释过了吗？不需要你特地做什么，再次拥有管理员之后，你目前所在的世界，将自动成为了‘主世界’，有了根基的服务器，可以自动修复BUG……还有其它问题吗？”

“最后一个问题，你说的管理员权限，什么时候能够真正落实？我已经迫不及待想要把上次那个在我爆照时发藕片的家伙禁言了！”关立远问道。
“大概还有三个月吧！毕竟你之前被宇宙意志的青睐程度，是最低级别的，我需要帮你先将‘宇宙青睐’提升到正常会员的水平，之后才能开通你的权限……你现在所在的宇宙，等级相当高，改变其意志需要付出的能量，已经将万年以来我积攒的能量用掉近半了！”企鹅有些委屈的说道。
“没关系，等我开通了权限之后，马上把论坛币涨价，再搞些大礼包、节日充值之类的活动！”
“好主意！”
来自无数个宇宙，几乎各个都是“天之骄子”、或者正在成为“天之骄子”的路上的“大宇宙论坛”的会员们，还不知道他们的论坛币三个月以后就要涨价了……
至于在这三个月里，关立远能做的，依旧只有没事儿刷刷论坛！
“啧啧，每天都是‘宇宙八卦’板块的活跃度最高，‘八卦’果然是智慧生物的本能，天之骄子们也不例外！”
本小章还未完~.~，请点击下一页继续    喜欢次元论坛请大家
content_en:
Some people will answer "I traveled to a dangerous world", others will answer "There is no golden finger after traveling through time", and some people will answer "I was pinned to the ground after traveling through time"...
Well, Guan Liyuan said that he has encountered all three situations!
So Guan Liyuan decided to post a post on the "Big Universe Forum" with this topic to vent...
But just as he used his energy to enter the title of the post on the forum page that others could not see, a fat penguin jumped out, but the people around him still turned a blind eye to it. Obviously, this penguin, like the forum interface, was invisible to others.
"Hey, what do you mean there is no golden finger? Am I not your golden finger?"
The penguin fidgeted with his red scarf dissatisfiedly... Don't ask why he wears a scarf even though he is a penguin!
"Hey, the main reason is that I think that by saying that I don't have a golden finger, I can also deceive myself into saying that my golden finger has not awakened. If I admit that my golden finger is just a forum, there will be no hope at all!" Guan Liyuan communicated with the penguin in a silent way.
This is Guan Liyuan's biggest progress in the past month... He is finally able to control his silent communication with Penguin, and only let him hear what he wants to "say"!
"What does it mean to be 'just' a forum? Have you realized the status of the 'Great Universe Forum' in the forum world? This is a high-end forum that can only have one registered member in each universe and is completely invitation-only! Do you know what this means?"
"I know, usually people who do this kind of propaganda are liars." Guan Liyuan became even more disdainful.
"You, you are the most vicious slander in the entire universe... no, in all the universes combined! You must know that my purpose is: to create happiness with your heart!"
"..."
When Penguin saw that Guan Liyuan had stopped talking, he suddenly felt that he had finally convinced this ungrateful guy, although his eyes were still a little weird.
As if he felt that Guan Liyuan's silence was reflecting on his own mistakes, Penguin's tone also softened a little: "Don't be ignorant of the blessings. If it were not detected by the system, you are highly consistent with the soul fluctuation system of the creators of this server. Depending on how 'favored' you are by the will of the universe, the probability of becoming a forum member is negligible, let alone becoming a noble administrator like you are now!"
Being brainwashed is a very scary thing for intelligent creatures.
But Guan Liyuan said that he was repeatedly brainwashed by a fat penguin wearing a red scarf, making him accept that "the forum administrator is a glorious and great mission and responsibility as the successor of the communist cause"... This kind of brainwashing is simply harmless!
"Okay, let me confirm with you again. Are you sure that I am the only 'noble administrator' on the entire page?" Guan Liyuan asked.
"That's right, this forum has 'lost contact' with the creator world after it went online... But the good news is, other than that, everything went smoothly. Although countless bugs appeared after running for thousands of years, I discovered you again! You are the only soul with administrator qualifications in all connected universes. Now those bugs are no longer a problem!" Penguin said with relief.
"Let me explain in advance, permission dog... Well, I mean I can still be competent as an administrator, but I don't know anything about programmers..."
"Of course, haven't I explained it already? You don't need to do anything special. After you have an administrator again, the world you are currently in will automatically become the 'main world'. With a basic server, bugs can be automatically fixed... Are there any other problems?"
"The last question, when will the administrator rights you mentioned be implemented? I can't wait.I want to ban the guy who posted lotus root slices when I posted a photo last time! Guan Liyuan asked.
“About three months! After all, you were previously favored by the will of the universe, which was at the lowest level. I need to help you raise the "favor of the universe" to the level of a normal member before I can open your permissions... The universe you are in now is of a very high level, and the energy required to change its will has already used up nearly half of the energy I have accumulated over the past ten thousand years! Penguin said a little aggrievedly.
"It doesn't matter. After I open the permissions, I will immediately increase the price of the forum currency and organize some activities such as gift packages and holiday recharges! "
"Good idea! "
Members of the "Great Universe Forum" from countless universes, almost all of whom are "God's Proud Ones" or on the road to becoming "Heaven's Proud Ones", don't know that the price of their forum coins will increase in three months...
As for these three months, all Guan Liyuan can do is still browse the forum!
"Tsk tsk, the 'Universal Bagua' section is the most active every day. 'Bagua' is indeed the instinct of intelligent creatures, and the proud ones are no exception! "
